build_aimv2_model: build an AIMv2 vision model for image encoding using AIMv2Model with config and quantization settings
create_aimv2_transformer: create an AIMv2 transformer with configurable hidden layers and optional post-layer normalization
create_aimv2_attention: create an AIMv2 multi-head attention layer with QKV parallel linear projection and tensor-parallel support
create_aimv2_swiglu_ffn: create an AIMv2 SwiGLU feed-forward network with merged column-parallel fc13 and row-parallel fc2 layers
run_aimv2_preprocessor: run the AIMv2 ViT preprocessor to patch-embed and add positional embeddings to input pixel values
